claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: This is generic marketing/product description text, not a claim about this specific unit's condition, completeness, or history. It matches the model already identified by the witness but proves nothing about the actual item's state.
Photo 0 and Photo 2 show Canon logo and label plate confirming brand and model.

risks.risk: No lens included, and body cap is on the mount
risks.proof: Photo of any included lens, or explicit confirmation none is included
Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checking tool or software, or a clear photo of the rear screen showing this info via menu
risks.if_unproven: price as heavily used, high shutter count

risks.risk: Sensor/interior condition (dust, fungus, scratches) not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo through the mount with mirror up, or a test photo against a plain white/grey background
risks.if_unproven: price as sensor uninspected, assume needs cleaning

risks.risk: Functionality of buttons, dials, autofocus, shutter unverified
risks.proof: Short video clip powering on the camera, operating dials, firing shutter, and autofocus cycling with a lens attached
risks.if_unproven: price as untested, assume partially non-functional

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of battery and charger alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: price as body only, no battery/charger

risks.proof: Photo of memory card inserted or included in sale
risks.if_unproven: price as no memory card included

risks.risk: No strap, case, cables, manual, or original box shown
risks.if_unproven: price as bare body only, no accessories

risks.risk: LCD screen cosmetic condition (scratches, dead pixels) not clearly shown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen powered on displaying an image or menu
risks.if_unproven: price as screen condition unknown, assume cosmetic wear

risks.proof: Photos of screws/seals for tamper signs, or seller-provided repair receipts
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown history, assume possible prior repair

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, shutter firing, and autofocus working with a lens attached
Shutter count screenshot or software readout
Photo of battery, charger, memory card, and any included accessories
Close-up photo of sensor (mirror up) and of LCD screen while powered on
response.reason: Identity (Canon EOS 5D Mark II body) is confirmed by the witness, but no condition, functionality, or accessory claims are verifiable from the report or the seller's generic text, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested body-only unit pending proof.
